# Skills

This page groups methods and technologies by domain. The emphasis is on practical evidence rather than an unqualified list of keywords.

## Software engineering

- **Python** — advanced practical experience reported; relevant evidence includes module design, typing, automated tests, and maintainability.
- **Software quality** — separation of concerns, data validation, testing, and reproducibility.
- **Backend development** — Java, APIs, and software architecture, to be detailed against confirmed professional experience.

## Data science and machine learning

- Data analysis and model development
- Classification metrics, model comparison, threshold analysis, and error analysis
- Validation methodology, data leakage, calibration, and generalisation
- Mathematical and statistical foundations, with theory distinguished from implementation experience

## LLMs and knowledge engineering

- Evaluation of hallucination-detection systems and fact-checking approaches
- Benchmark design, metric aggregation, and threshold studies
- Source ingestion, structured knowledge generation, validation, and search

## Scientific computing and environmental modelling

- Applied mathematics, numerical simulation, and algorithmic methods
- Fluid mechanics and atmospheric/environmental dispersion topics, subject to confirmation of the specific work and terminology

Tools and frameworks will be linked to the projects or roles in which they were actually used. Brief experimentation alone is not presented as mastery.
